project.name: Brightpath Academy
project.description: Brightpath Academy online learning platform backend with courses, ordered lessons, quizzes, and learner enrollments

app.name: Brightpath Academy
app.tagline: Calm, structured online learning with guided courses and interactive lessons

help.status: Course status: draft, published, or unpublished

looks.reason: Calm and studious aesthetic with soft elevation, ample whitespace, and focused learning spaces.
Structured typographical hierarchy and clean grid suited for course syllabi, lessons, and categorized catalogues.
Approachable, friendly rounded surfaces that make self-paced learning and quizzes engaging.

requested.words: calm and studious, plenty of white space, a deep teal accent

design.reason: Brightpath Academy balances a structured multi-category course catalog and focused lesson study environment for learners with editorial workspace tools for instructors and administrators.

tours.name: Course Learning and Completion
tours.outcome: The learner progresses through lessons in order and completes the course.

steps.title: Browse course catalog (the course becomes published). Rule: Only published courses are visible in the catalog
Enroll in course (the enrollment becomes active). Rule: Learner must not already be enrolled
Resume course where left off (the enrollment becomes active). Rule: Resume at the earliest incomplete lesson
Mark lesson complete (the lesson becomes completed). Rule: Lessons must be completed in order
Complete course (the enrollment becomes completed). Rule: All lessons in the course must be completed

tours.name: Course Authoring and Publishing
tours.outcome: A complete, structured course is published for learners to enroll in.

steps.title: Create course outline (the course becomes draft). Rule: Course must belong to an existing category
Add ordered lesson (the lesson becomes draft). Rule: Lesson must be video or written page, with optional quiz
Publish course (the course becomes published). Rule: Course must have at least one lesson before publishing
